column1: # LIVE — Last real data refresh: 2026-06-30 (newest filed quarter) | Staleness sweep: 2026-08-28 | Next: Q3-2026 10-Q ~2026-11-06

# NON-ACCRUAL FLOW LEDGER — the decomposition THESIS v1.0 rests on. Built 2026-08-28 by FLG at its first live session from 13 EDGAR filings (10-Q/10-K, Flagstar Bank N.A., CIK 0000910073, 2023Q2..2026Q2). Source-authority: PRIMARY — FLG pulled and parsed every filing itself.

# ⚠️ BASIS IS LOAD-BEARING AND DECLARED PER ROW. `YTD-as-filed` = figures exactly as printed: CUMULATIVE FROM DEC 31 of the prior year, NOT quarterly. `Q-derived` = successive YTD differences within one fiscal year, computed by FLG, NOT a filed figure. Never mix the two in one comparison; never annualise a YTD row (the ×2 error that overstated the seed's charge-offs ~15%).
# ⚠️ EXPECTED-STALE BY CONSTRUCTION between filings — quarterly regulatory cadence, as with MI3_FLG.tsv. Stale after ~2026-11-13 IS neglect.

# IDENTITY CHECK: begin + new + acquired + charge-offs + transfers + payoffs + cures = end, per filing. 13/13 TIE EXACTLY. Not decoration — it caught two real parser defects at build: a missing 'acquired from acquisition' category, and a line reading 'New non-accrual, INCLUDING acquired from acquisition' that matched two labels and double-counted the inflow. A row that does not tie must not be used.

# ⚠️ COHORT-INCOMPARABLE, verified by REGINALD 2026-08-28 (n=3 at primary): WAL/EGBN/CFG disclose ACL roll-forwards but NOT non-accrual roll-forwards; the cure line is FR Y-14Q Schedule H (non-public). No peer denominator exists for these shares. Treat every share here as a SINGLE-NAME time series, never as a cohort percentile.
# SIGN CONVENTION: inflows positive, outflows negative. total_outflow is the POSITIVE magnitude of all outflow legs; shares are of total_outflow.
